emails.subject_line_a: Quick HVAC build for Reliable Air LLC
emails.body_text:
Hi Reliable Air LLC team,

I was looking at reliableairaz.com — huge respect for staying fiercely independent and 3rd-generation family-owned across Phoenix since 1996.

One mobile leak caught my eye: reliableairaz.com has zero embedded instant quote estimator on the homepage — pushing Valley homeowners shopping replacement units off-site without seeing a local SEER2 ballpark.

So I built a working 30-second Phoenix HVAC Estimator in your royal-and-sky-blue Reliable Air LLC branding. Homeowners pick home size, system type, SEER2 tier, and ductwork for an instant local ballpark before leaving their name, phone, and address.

Mind if I send the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

linkedin_dm_touch.connection_note: Hi Reliable Air LLC team, Big fan of Reliable Air LLC in Phoenix. I noticed reliableairaz.com has no instant HVAC ballpark tool for mobile shoppers, so I built a working <30KB SEER2 estimator in your brand colors. Happy to send the live link — no pitch.
linkedin_dm_touch.follow_up_dm: Thanks for connecting! Here is the working Phoenix HVAC replacement calculator I built for Reliable Air LLC: {{preview_url}} — drops onto reliableairaz.com in 5 minutes with zero redesign.

loom_60s_script.hook_0_15s: Open https://reliableairaz.com/ on mobile and acknowledge Reliable Air LLC's local Phoenix reputation while showing the missing instant ballpark.
loom_60s_script.pain_comparison_15_35s: Contrast reliableairaz.com has zero embedded instant quote estimator on the homepage — pushing Valley homeowners shopping replacement units off-site without seeing a local SEER2 ballpark with how after-hours AC replacement shoppers expect a rough SEER2 and monthly payment preview.
loom_60s_script.live_demo_walkthrough_35_50s: Click through Steps 1–4 on live {{preview_url}} (3–3.5 ton Central AC + Gas Furnace 16–18 SEER2 = $10,200–$14,800, from $135/mo) and submit a sample lead with street address.
loom_60s_script.zero_pressure_cta_50_60s: Show the live trojan:lead_captured CRM webhook payload and invite there to drop the 1-line <30 KB script onto reliableairaz.com for $750 setup + $149/mo.

objection_handlers.objection: We do not want to publish exact prices without doing a Manual-J load calculation.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Totally agree — that is why the widget intentionally displays a realistic Phoenix installed range ($10,200–$14,800) with a Manual-J confirmation disclaimer so tire-kickers self-filter and serious homeowners book.

objection_handlers.objection: We already use ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, or our own contact form.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: This drops right alongside your existing stack and fires a clean JSON webhook (tonnage, system type, SEER2 tier, ductwork, and street address) directly into your dispatch inbox, SMS, or CRM.

objection_handlers.objection: Will adding a calculator slow down our site or break our theme?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero external libraries and under 30 KB of pure Shadow DOM vanilla JS — installs with one script tag in 5 minutes and cannot conflict with existing CSS or hurt Core Web Vitals.

objection_handlers.objection: Why is there a $149/mo retainer after the $750 setup?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: It covers global Cloudflare edge hosting, instant lead routing uptime, and quarterly SEER2 equipment/financing price updates whenever distributor costs shift — a single extra system replacement pays for years of it.
